segments.title: This red panda just turned 23
segments.say: Meet Futa. At twenty three, the world's oldest red panda.

segments.title: Most live 12 to 17 years
segments.say: Most red pandas live twelve to seventeen years. Futa is twenty three.

segments.title: The old record: 21 years
segments.say: The old record holder, Taylor at ZooMontana, reached twenty one. Now Futa holds the record.

segments.title: Home: a zoo in Chiba, Japan
segments.say: Futa lives at a zoo in Chiba, Japan. Futa was born in two thousand three.
